Third-party notices for Open Math Harness

Open Math Harness includes material from the projects below. Each project's
license applies only to the material named here; the rest of this repository is
licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE).

OpenAI Codex
  https://github.com/openai/codex, commit c45ea25 (2026-09-20)
  License: Apache License 2.0 (LICENSE)
  The notice of the original:

      OpenAI Codex
      Copyright 2025 OpenAI

  What was adapted: the agent prompts in prompts/templates/ and the way
  prompts/src/ assembles them, and the memory templates in
  memories/read/templates/ and memories/write/templates/ with the citation
  format memories/read reads. That covers the per-model instructions and
  personalities, the permissions texts, the guardian policy, the compaction
  handoff, the agent role file (the swarm member's), and the memory
  pipeline's reading, extraction and consolidation prompts.
  These files were modified: their text is rewritten for this
  system's tools and services, and some of Codex's wording remains.

DeepSeek Harness
  https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness, AGENTS.md at commit adce1b4
  (2026-09-17)
  License: MIT License (MIT text below)
  The notice of the original:

      Copyright (c) 2026 DeepSeek

  Nucleus's design learned from it: an agent harness built as a microkernel,
  with agent loops, models and tools as replaceable plugins. What was adapted:
  development conventions of its AGENTS.md, rewritten for this system in
  AGENTS.md: a capability's interface, provider and consumers; rebuilding what
  a model was given from the session log; registrations that own their
  release; validating input where it enters and trusting typed code inside;
  validated configuration, fixed protocol constants and security invariants,
  and misconfiguration that fails early; maintained dependencies over
  hand-written code; pre-stable interfaces and the migration of released
  data; checks matched to the changed surface.

asn1-rs-impl 0.2.0

  Copyright (c) 2017 Pierre Chifflier
  Distributed under its MIT option (MIT text below).
